ABOUT Healthcare offers AI-enabled solutions to optimize patient throughput across the acute care journey. The Associate Software Engineer writes, updates, tests, and reviews software using AI coding agents, contributes to technical direction, supports the agentic engineering program and Agentic Software Development Lifecycle, and takes on special projects while learning new technologies quickly.
Healthcare
Information Technology
Software
Health Care
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Serves as a team member to understand product deliverables and outcomes; contributes to technical direction to define the technology and solution
Writes, updates or modifies code to deliver stated objectives, performance and outcomes, using AI coding agents as a primary means of delivery
Applies engineering judgment to agent output — reviews, tests and corrects generated code rather than accepting it uncritically
Helps maintain and advance the team’s agentic engineering program and Agentic Software Development Lifecycle, including agent workflows, prompts, skills and supporting tooling
Takes on special projects with limited direction, learning unfamiliar technology quickly to solve the problem at hand
Participates in peer review or analysis to reduce or eliminate causes of failures, bugs or unexpected results
Provides research and feedback to resolve management and client questions and requirements
Analyzes and reviews software and products on an ongoing and as needed basis to determine trends, draw conclusions, interpret findings, and presents results, proposals and recommendations to management
Ensures the accuracy of software, reports, and related details through audits, queries, and operational reviews; works with teams to resolve discrepancies
Contributes to the efficiency and effectiveness of the department’s service to its customers by offering suggestions and participating as an active member of a work team
Performs other duties as assigned

Required
Bachelor's degree in information technology or related
Exposure to software development experience
1+ years of software development experience
An understanding of principles, practices and techniques of software development
Approaches to perform peer review or analysis
Working knowledge of at least one high-level programming language, such as C#, Java or TypeScript
Agentic coding — using AI coding agents to plan, write, test and review software
A willingness and ability to pick up new languages, frameworks and tools quickly
Technology project management principles and approaches
Various methods to identify and resolve software failures, bugs or unexpected results
Exposure to methods and approaches to analyze and improve software performance
Principles and practices to serving as an effective project team member
Able to effectively communicate with staff, coworkers, and customers
Correct business English, including spelling, grammar and punctuation
Performing software development in a variety of areas, using AI coding agents where they add leverage
Framing a problem clearly enough to direct an AI agent to a working, reviewable solution
Exercising high agency — identifying what needs doing, then driving it to completion with limited direction
Developing software approaches to meet requirements and performance, following established coding standards, patterns, and methodologies
Participating in code reviews and with constructive feedback
Troubleshooting and resolving software failures, bugs or unexpected results
Following software plans, approaches and techniques
Operating in both a team and individual contributor environment
Using initiative and independent judgment within established department guidelines
Contributing effectively to the accomplishment of team or work unit goals, objectives and activities
Establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with a variety of individuals
Mobility to work in an office setting, use standard office equipment and stamina to sit for extended periods of time; strength to lift and carry up to 10 pounds; vision to read printed materials and computer screens; and hearing and speech to communicate in person or over the telephone
Travel as needed to support company and customer initiatives
Work on Site at our St Paul office may be required and ABOUT reserves the right to change the location of the role at any time
Preferred
Enrolled in master's program for information technology, software development, or similar
Experience extending or customizing agentic development tooling (agents, skills, MCP servers, CI automation)
Personal or open-source projects that show initiative and self-directed learning
Preferred experience working on web application in a cloud-based architecture
